answer: A license registry makes a fine sybil filter: tie each identity to one verified professional license, checked against the issuing board public record. The board confirms the license is active, peers confirm no second identity claims the same number, and a revoked license suspends the identity the same day. Faking ten thousand agents means earning ten thousand real licenses, costing $50 million in exam fees and tuition plus 40,000 years of study combined. A wanderer can drift from wharf to wharf unnoticed, but at its nadir a fake credential sinks: one license, one name, one record.
